blocks.text: Although one of Agentic SOC’s biggest benefits is its ability to use multiple AI agents to ingest vast amounts of alert data to create specific and actionable incidents, you might also want to create custom incidents based on your organization’s business needs. You can create a custom incident based on one or more alerts from the collated list available on the Alerts page in Agentic SOC.

blocks.item: Access the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal.
From the top navigation, click Agentic SOC.
In the left-side navigation, go to Alerts.
Select one or more alerts from the list, then click Create Incident.
The Create Incident from Alerts drawer opens.
In the Create Incident from Alerts drawer:
Severity: Select a severity level (e.g., High, Medium, Low) from the drop-down menu.
Status: Select a status (e.g., Discovered, Remediated, Confirmed) from the drop-down menu.
Title: Enter a title for the incident, or use the title automatically generated by Agentic SOC.
Verdict: Select a verdict (e.g., Accepted, Executed, Partial) from the drop-down menu.
You receive a confirmation message and the incident appears on the Incidents page.
